name: agentmon-live
description: AgentMon Live: live pane with the main session, tool calls (git highlighted), subagents, session log and a Fable advisor that reads along

language.title: Language
language.description: Pane, status line and advisor language: en, de, fr, es, zh, ja

advisorModel.title: Advisor model
advisorModel.description: Model the Fable advisor runs on

advisorMode.title: Advisor mode
advisorMode.description: all: before Claude stops, unfinished work (failed or stale checks, open todos, failing subagents, and parts of the request Fable finds unanswered) goes back to it once; gate: the same without a model; off: no gate; plan: the old name of gate

advisorBudget.title: Advisor call budget
advisorBudget.description: Most Fable calls per session; 0 means no limit

sizeLimit.title: File-size guide
sizeLimit.description: Bytes a maintained source file may reach before Focus suggests splitting it (about 5,000 tokens at 20000, a heuristic); 0 turns the guide off

sizeExclude.title: File-size exclusions
sizeExclude.description: Comma-separated globs the guide skips, added to the built-in lockfile, generated, vendored, build and fixture patterns

learning.title: Learning
learning.description: on: remember tool failures, compactions and MCP use per project across sessions, and check memory files; off: nothing is kept
